# `aitbc agent config-export`

Export a named agent's configuration to a JSON file.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc agent config-export [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--name` | text | — | yes | Agent name. |
| `--output-path` | text | — | yes | The Output path. |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc agent config-export --name <name> --output-path <output_path>
```
